title: The Interior of the coast road
author: Emrys Brightwater
blurb: Theo Joubert, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
